“Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
translations.bsb: The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
translations.kjv: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
translations.asv: but the other proclaim Christ of faction, not sincerely, thinking to raise up affliction for me in my bonds.
